tells.label: Car explodes into fireball
tells.detail: The silver sedan suddenly bursts into a large fireball between frames 3 and 4, which is not physically plausible in normal traffic.

note.text: This video shows impossible physics, morphing objects and transformations inconsistent with real events and is likely AI-generated or CGI, not authentic captured footage.
